name: Shadow consistency

detection.task: Is one constraint inconsistent with the others (as an object pasted in under another light or perspective)?
detection.positives: 120 sets of 3, 5 or 8 constraints per angle, one turned by the stated angle
detection.negatives: 120 consistent sets with simulated click error (sigma 1 and 2 px)

known_failure_modes: Detects a conflict only when the turned constraint leaves the others' feasible region: a pasted object lit from a similar direction (small angle) passes, and with few constraints the region is wide (see tpr_by_turn_angle).

Wrongly paired shadow and object points, extended or diffuse lights, and shadows on non-planar ground produce false conflicts; synthetic constraints cannot measure how often examiners mis-pair points.
